concept.title: How to set up a print server
concept.shortdesc: The objective of a print server is to streamline and optimize printing tasks throughout the network. The print server works as an intermediary between client computers and printers, handling print jobs and ensuring efficient print management.

ul.li: Ensure you have administrative rights on the server.
Ensure SNMP is enabled on the network.

section.title: Steps to set up a print server

ol.li: Log in to the Windows Server (2019 or 2022) with administrative credentials.
Open the 'Server Manager' from the Start menu.
Click on 'Add roles and features' to launch the wizard.
In the 'Before you begin' window, click 'Next'.
Select 'Role-based or feature-based installation' and click 'Next'.
Choose the server from the server pool and click 'Next'.
In the 'Select server roles' window, check 'Print and Document Services' and click 'Next'.
In the 'Print and Document Services' window, click 'Next'.
Confirm the installation selections and click 'Install'.
Once the installation is complete, click 'Close'.
